verses.text: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.

segments.text: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart:
Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.

verses.text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

segments.text: I will worship toward thy holy temple,
And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth:
For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.text: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.

segments.text: In the day that I called thou answeredst me,
Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.

verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

segments.text: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah,
For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

verses.text: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.

segments.text: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah;
For great is the glory of Jehovah.

verses.text: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.

segments.text: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly;

verses.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.

segments.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me;

And thy right hand will save me.

verses.text: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
